security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Uploads your World of Warcraft combat logs to mythics.gg
bundle.longDescription: Reads World of Warcraft's combat log text file and uploads your boss pulls and Mythic+ keys to mythics.gg, live and from past logs. It never reads the game's memory or automates play, and runs safely alongside the Warcraft Logs uploader.
